name: Wallble: Guest Book & Wall of Love
author: Wallble

sections.description:
Wallble adds a live, interactive guest book wall to any post or page. Visitors write messages, upload photos, record voice notes, or draw sketches, and everything appears instantly on a beautiful masonry wall.

What makes it different from a classic guest book plugin:

  • Photos, voice notes and sketches, not just text entries.
  • Nothing to manage in WordPress. Posts live on Wallble’s servers, not in your WordPress database or moderation queue.
  • No setup. Create a wall in seconds, paste its ID, done.
  • Works everywhere. Gutenberg block and a classic [wallble] shortcode.
  • Right-to-left ready. Walls render in English or Arabic, matching the wall’s own language.

Use it as:

  • A guest book for your blog or portfolio
  • A wall of love / testimonials wall for your product
  • A birthday, wedding, graduation or retirement message board
  • A visitor book for events and communities

How it works

This plugin embeds walls from Wallble (wallble.com), a third-party hosted service. The wall content is loaded in an iframe served by wallble.com; creating a wall requires a free Wallble account. Free walls hold up to 10 posts; premium walls are unlimited. See the Wallble terms and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Create a free wall at wallble.com/start (takes under a minute).
  3. Copy your wall ID: it is the part after wallble.com/ in your wall link.
  4. Add the “Wallble Wall” block to any page, or use the shortcode: [wallble id="yourwallid"].
  5. Optionally set a default wall ID under Settings > Wallble so the shortcode works without arguments.
sections.faq:
Do visitors need an account to post?

No. Anyone who can see the wall can post a message, photo, voice note or sketch without signing up.

Where is the content stored?

On Wallble’s servers (wallble.com). Nothing is stored in your WordPress database except the wall ID you configure.

Can I moderate posts?

Yes. As the wall owner you can erase any post from the wall on wallble.com, and visitors can report posts.

Is it free?

The plugin is free. Free walls hold up to 10 posts; a one-time premium upgrade makes a wall unlimited.

Does it slow my site down?

No. The wall loads lazily in an iframe, after your page has rendered.
